note: RV park on South Fork Saline Creek about a mile from I-55 near Perryville, open field with gravel pads; the creek runs past the playground and pavilion at the east end, reached by a path and covered bridge. Contactless check-in. --Claude
summary: Rate found on the operator's booking engine: $35 base (W/E 30/50A), $41 high, full hookup +4 (2026 and spring 2027 alike); confirmed 50A/water/sewer; added 41 sites, 80 ft, pull-throughs, showers/water/wifi, online booking 180 days out. Not waterfront kept (pads 40-60 m from the creek through trees/playground). Reported Campendium rates dropped from the note.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): rate $35 base / $41 high on the operator's own Park With Us booking engine (read 2026-11-07 for 2026-11-17 and 2027-04-16) - under $50, no gateway needed; Good Sam: not in the directory within 2.5 km; presence passes - working booking site with phone (573) 768-0414, Google Maps 4.7 stars / 41 reviews with the same phone; RV Life 4.5 stars, $$.

LONG-STAY: no weekly/monthly rate marketed (the booker's long-term booking is off); 14 of the 45 catalog RV units are not bookable online, which may be long-term or held sites. Reviews read are transient (vacation, couples, families who 'camp here three to four times a year', 'You can choose your lot ... during your online booking process'); one 3-star review (2 months ago) faults the single shared washroom/shower. Read as transient: keep. Reviews were read in relevance order (Newest sort failed).

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: South Fork Saline Creek is ~12-18 m wide (creek). On the operator's map the creek runs past the east end beyond the pavilion, playground and 'Creek Access' path; the nearest pads (20, 21) are ~40-60 m from the bank through a wooded strip and the pavilion/playground ground. Esri imagery predates the pads, so per-pad distances are from the map scaled onto the loop. Not on-water; creekview not established through the trees - unsure, kept down.

PIN: stored 37.7276,-89.9340 is on the west end (entrance and storage lot by Hwy T), ~180 m from the middle of the site loop (37.7271,-89.9320); within tolerance, kept. The booker's own point is 37.72728,-89.93373.
